---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem / motivation**
What are you trying to do, and what's getting in the way today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see. Keep it scoped — the project favors minimal, purpose-built changes.

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches you thought about, if any.

**Privacy note**
AgentWrangler is local-only and keeps no raw transcript/PR content (aggregates and ids only).
Please confirm your idea fits that model, or call out where it might not.

**Additional context**
Anything else — screenshots, links, examples.
